Issue.title: Want to complete a premium quote on the portal
Issue.description: The agency representative is trying to do a premium quote and needs to finish it via the portal

Issue.title: Cannot access the portal due to 'Your connection is not private' warning
Issue.description: While attempting the premium quote, the browser shows a 'Your connection is not private' message with a red padlock and the representative cannot proceed past that screen

Issue.title: Do not know why the privacy warning occurs
Issue.description: After encountering the 'Your connection is not private' message, the representative asks why the error is happening

Solution.title: Contact agency IT to update the web browser's security certificates
Solution.description: Because the error is due to local PC settings, the representative should submit a request to EEE Agency's IT to update/fix the browser security certificates so the portal can be accessed

Solution.title: Recognize that the issue is due to local browser security certificates, not the portal or account
Solution.description: The helpdesk confirms the account is active and explains that this specific warning typically results from issues with the web browser's security certificates on the representative's computer
